summary.headline: Valens’s Zodiacal Geography
summary.text: Scholarly discussion of Valens’s geographical astrology: the zodiacal regions, lands, cities, and rivers assigned to each sign, and the dating and possible Hipparchan origin of the underlying Egyptian source. The argument cites Ptolemy, Posidonius, Hephaestio, Firmicus Maternus, and Paul of Alexandria, with examples including Carthage, Corinth, Galatia, Parthia, Rhodes, and Cos.
